why: Fix round after review 1 of slice E61 (ticket 1075, check preferNamespaceImport), in our tooling. The review's one fault: the installed effect 4.1.3 has no effect/unstable exports, and its platform modules are lowercase one-level barrels (effect/http, effect/process, effect/sql, effect/ai and 19 more), so the ruling's literal "!effect/*" let them into the settings files. In .oxlintrc.json, the SettingsRuntime group (line 1864) and the settings contracts group (line 1898) now negate "!effect/[A-Z]*" with "caseSensitive": true, so only Effect's capitalized core modules pass. This differs from the ruling's literal "!effect/*" but keeps its intent (core Effect only, every platform module closed). Proved first on a scratch copy of the config: all 23 lowercase platform barrels and effect/http/HttpClient refused in settings/Starts.ts and cloudflare/SettingsRuntime.ts; Context, Effect, Schema, Config, Duration, Exit, Scope, Layer, ManagedRuntime and ScopedCache allowed (the contracts still refuse Layer, ManagedRuntime and ScopedCache by path, as designed). In the law "T753 L15 settings files import only Effect's core modules" (oxlint-plugins/plants.test.ts, renamed from "... one subpath deep"), the two effect/unstable rows per file became installed forms, effect/http/HttpClient and effect/http, and an effect/process row was added, in each contract file and the holder; every banned-module row and allowed row is kept; the comment's "all three groups" is fixed to the two groups and names the new plants. Red before the config fix: 6 rows (effect/http and effect/process in Starts.ts, RecordedStart.ts and SettingsRuntime.ts) green where they must be refused; effect/http/HttpClient was already refused. The three hits kept for the new seam (cloudflare/control.ts:9, cloudflare/readers.laws.test.ts:13, cloudflare/SettingsRuntime.ts:8) were not touched. No product file changed. Ran: oxlint-plugins/plants.test.ts whole (264 passed) at a7c2824 plus this change; pnpm format; pnpm lint with NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144 exit 0; ratchet exit 0.
note: The ruling's "!effect/*" assumes the effect-smol beta layout with an unstable folder; the lead should tell the merge session the committed pattern is "!effect/[A-Z]*" with caseSensitive, and why.
